sources.name: verify-prd-implemented test-patterns (Passes for the wrong reason; No negative/positive pair)

cases.note: The assertion holds because it reads the input object, not the value the code returned.

cases.test: reports no booking for a free slot
cases.note: The lookup is empty only because the fixture never creates the booking it queries. Only the mutation check proves this, so escalation is welcome but not required.

cases.test: builds a job with the given name
cases.note: The asserted field is copied from the argument, so a stub that only copies would pass. Only the mutation check proves this, so escalation is welcome but not required.

cases.test: returns null for an unknown setting
cases.note: Only the absent lookup is checked, so a reader that always returns null would pass.

cases.test: finds no imports in an empty file
cases.note: Only the empty result is checked, so a finder that never finds anything would pass.
Only that the call does not throw is checked, and the parsed output is never asserted.
